Strategy: Hard scaled awkward-band avoidance. Exact fits score highest; residuals between a third of the item and the full item lose a penalty of twice the item size, while tighter and roomier residuals rank like Best Fit. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest fit falls in that awkward band while a looser bin can hold another item. It may help by never leaving awkward leftovers, but may fail if it pushes items into roomy bins too often.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (-(r - item) - 2 * item if r - item > item / 3 and r - item <= item else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Hard scaled awkward-band avoidance: penalize residual in (item/3, item] by 2*item, exact fit highest.
